seed_protocol: int.from_bytes(SHA256(ASCII('C-NBI-v2/phase10b/v1/{master}/{scenario_id}/{replica_id}'))[:16], 'big'); PCG64(seed); replica0 is exclusively external Sobol

ccd.ordering: lexicographic factorials (-1,+1); axes ascending (-alpha,+alpha); five centers

noise.distribution: Gaussian additive iid across rows, responses and replicas
noise.signal_variance: sample variance of analytic values on complete CCD including five centers; ddof=1
noise.previous_protocol_search: No validated conflicting 95% signal protocol found in docs/src/scripts/tests at d68aef7

rsm.terms: intercept; linears; pure squares; lexicographic pairwise interactions
rsm.hessian_classification: STRICTLY_CONVEX iff minimum eigenvalue > 0; no tolerance correction
rsm.covariance: raw E.T@E/(n-p); no shrinkage, jitter or positive-definiteness enforcement

external_validation.sampler: unchanged Phase10A sample_ball(nx,12,seed), uniform volume Sobol
external_validation.stream: replica0, separate from noise and Phase10A calibration/validation

summary: equal weight per response model; linear quantiles; group by nx,delta,rho_target,scenario_id and all
